housing.summary: Average 1-bedroom apartment in Windsor city centre is approximately CAD 1,660/month per Numbeo (Jun 2026). Ontario landlords typically require first and last month's rent as deposit. Kijiji.ca is the primary rental portal.

banking.summary: Major Canadian banks serve Windsor. Newcomers need passport, immigration document, proof of Ontario address, and SIN if available. RBC and Scotiabank both offer newcomer banking packages. Windsor is close to the US border with access to cross-border banking services.
required_docs: Immigration document (work permit, study permit, or PR card)

schools.summary: Windsor is served by the Greater Essex County District School Board (public) and Windsor-Essex Catholic District School Board. The GECDSB offers ESL, French as a Second Language, International Languages, and Special Education programs. International student programs are also available.

legal_admin.summary: Newcomers on work or study permits must notify IRCC of address changes via the IRCC portal. Permanent residents update SIN address with Service Canada. Ontario drivers must exchange a foreign licence within 60 days of becoming an Ontario resident.
legal_admin.registration_step: Update address with IRCC at ircc.canada.ca if on work/study permit; permanent residents update SIN address at Service Canada.

tax_finance.summary: A Social Insurance Number (SIN) is Canada's tax identification number, issued by Service Canada. Required for work, tax filing, and government benefits. Apply at a Service Canada office or online.

transport.summary: Transit Windsor operates the city bus network. Numbeo reports an average monthly transit pass of CAD 122.50 for Windsor. Transit Windsor is located at 300 Chatham Street West. Foreign drivers must exchange licence within 60 days in Ontario. Ontario OHIP health card coverage is available with no waiting period upon eligibility approval.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: Foreign licence holders must exchange to an Ontario licence within 60 days of becoming an Ontario resident. Apply at a ServiceOntario centre (ontario.ca).
transport.healthcare_registration: Apply for OHIP (Ontario Health Insurance Plan) at a ServiceOntario location. There is no longer a waiting period — coverage begins immediately upon approval. Bring immigration documents, proof of Ontario residency, and proof of identity.
